answer_1.quote: Automatic Question Generation (QG) is the task of generating question-answer pairs from a declarative sentence

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of our models using BLEU and ROUGE-L, which are widely used in previous QG works.

answer_4.quote: we perform a human evaluation to compare our model with the strong baseline of Graph2seq +RL+ BERT. We randomly select 100 samples from SQuAD and ask three annotators to score these generated questions according to three aspects: Fluency: measures whether a question is grammatical and fluent; Relevancy: measures whether the question is relevant to the input context; Answerability: indicates whether the question can be answered by the given answer.
answer_4.guideline: Fluency: measures whether a question is grammatical and fluent; Relevancy: measures whether the question is relevant to the input context; Answerability: indicates whether the question can be answered by the given answer.
